risks.title: Dependence on FERC Regulatory Approvals
risks.summary: Delays or denials of approval by FERC could block strategic projects and impact the revenue growth trajectory from transportation.
risks.score_rationale: Several key projects (Transco Gulf Gillis, Southeast Supply Enhancement, Northeast Supply Enhancement) depend on FERC approvals, with recurring conditional language such as 'assuming timely receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals'. Delays or denials could block strategic revenue growth. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Loss of Regulated Accounting Treatment
risks.summary: Loss of regulated accounting treatment would lead to significant asset reclassifications and high impacts on net income.
risks.score_rationale: The document indicates that if Transco or NWP lose regulated status, regulated assets and liabilities would be reclassified, directly impacting results. Strong language regarding immediate financial consequences. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Commodity Derivatives Volatility
risks.summary: Fair value fluctuations of commodity derivatives introduce significant earnings volatility despite economic hedges.
risks.score_rationale: The Gas NGL Marketing Services segment exposes WMB to fair value accounting for commodity derivatives, generating significant volatility in unrealized gains and losses. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk of Non-Recovery of Regulated Costs
risks.summary: Recognition of regulated assets relies on expected recovery through tariffs by regulators, which is subject to change.
risks.score_rationale: Recognition of regulated assets depends on the anticipated probability of tariff recovery, a judgment subject to changes in regulatory policy or disputes. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Expansion Projects for Growth
risks.summary: Growth strategy heavily depends on the success and timing of numerous ongoing and future expansion projects.
risks.score_rationale: Revenue growth in 2025 is driven by expansion projects placed in service (Deepwater Whale, Deepwater Shenandoah, Texas to Louisiana Energy Pathway). Major upcoming projects (Gulf Gillis, Southeast Supply Enhancement) extend into 2027, with concentration and delay risks. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Volume Risk on MVC Contracts
risks.summary: Decline in customer committed volumes under MVC contracts may reduce revenues, particularly in upstream activities.
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions a decline in MVC (Minimum Volume Commitments) revenues in certain segments, indicating exposure to customer non-commitment of future volumes. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Operational Risk on Greenfield Projects
risks.summary: New construction projects (greenfield) require additional capital and carry technical and scheduling risks.
risks.score_rationale: Greenfield projects such as Driftwood Pipeline (Line 200) carry typical construction risks: cost overruns, execution delays, and technical complexity. (default score, to be refined)
